## An edition is a record

A publication version is more than a label on a cover. It identifies the reviewed manuscript set, canonical URL, publication date, sources, figures, and correction history that belong together.

The PDF builder uses invariant document settings and records both a source digest and a final file checksum. Rebuilding unchanged inputs should produce the same bytes. If the manuscript changes, the source digest changes and the release must move through review as a new edition.

## Corrections stay visible

Errata are scoped to a book and edition. A correction records where the problem appeared, what changed, and when it was resolved. Stable public routes let a reader verify a printed copy even after a newer edition exists.
